anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Witte p.112 / PDF 116. Heavily lacunose page.
Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Quoted wording: συμπόσια συμπόσια, group by group.

choices.lemma: λέγων πρὸς τοὺς μαθητάς / τοὺς λαοὺς ἀνακλίνειν
choices.choice: tells the disciples to have the crowds recline
choices.rejected: telling the crowds to recline the disciples on grass
choices.why: Accusative-and-infinitive: crowds recline; the speech is to the disciples.

pass_a_gloss: [gap] For, speaking to the disciples, he tells them to have the crowds recline on grass, and advises this: Make them sit down group by group, and so he sets it before them.
pass_b_english: [lacuna] For, telling the disciples to have the crowds recline on grass, he advises this: Make them sit down group by group. And so he sets it before them.
source_text: [ ... Καὶ γὰ]ρ τοὺς λα[οὺς λέγων πρὸς τοὺς] μαθητ[ὰ]ς [ἀνακ]λίν[ειν ἐπὶ χόρτ]ῳ τοῦτο [παρ]αινεῖ[· Ποιήσα]τε γὰρ [ἀ]ναπεσεῖν [συμπόσια σ]υμπόσια, [κ]αὶ οὕτως π[α]ρατίθε[τ]αι αὐτοῖς.
